Description: Take control over your neighbors' TVs like you see in the movies! Google Chromecast is a handy little gadget that lets you stream video to your TV from a variety of sources like Netflix and YouTube. It also allows streaming from nearby hackers. I'll demonstrate how to hijack any Google Chromecast -- even if it's behind a secure Wi-Fi network -- to do your bidding. I’ll also be revealing a new tool to fully automate the hijacking and playing of arbitrary video to the victim's TV. Let the prank war commence.
